_comment: Thorough variant of stryker.config.json — uses coverageAnalysis: 'all' so module-load-time constants (e.g. permission-grants.ts grant-key Sets) are exercised by every test, not just tests Stryker thinks cover them. Slower (~3-5x wall time vs perTest) but accurate. Run via `pnpm mutate:thorough` or `pnpm mutate:thorough -- --mutate path/to/file.ts`.
_comment_ignore: Keep .claude (Claude Code worktrees + symlinked skills like .claude/skills/patch) and build outputs out of the sandbox copy. The patch symlink crashes the copy with ENOTSUP, and .claude/worktrees holds 11 full node_modules trees. ignorePatterns only affects what's copied into the sandbox, not what's mutated.
